subject: math
skillName: Telling Time to the Hour and Half-Hour

items.prompt: The hour hand points to $3$ and the minute hand points to $12$. What time is it?

steps: When the minute hand is on $12$, it is an o'clock time.
The hour hand is on $3$, so it is $3$ o'clock.

items.prompt: The minute hand points to $6$ and the hour hand is between $4$ and $5$. What time is it?

steps: When the minute hand is on $6$, it is half past the hour.
The hour hand is just past $4$, so it is half past $4$ (also written $4\!:\!30$).

items.prompt: What does it mean when the minute hand points to $12$?

steps: The minute hand on $12$ means the start of an hour.
It is an o'clock (on the hour) time.

items.prompt: The hour hand points to $8$ and the minute hand to $12$. What time is it?
The minute hand points to $6$ and the hour hand is between $9$ and $10$. What time is it?

steps: Minute hand on $6$ means half past.

items.prompt: How many minutes is it from one o'clock mark to half past?

steps: Half of an hour is $30$ minutes.
